messages:
Kai: Quick check: who took the last piece of avocado toast from the kitchen? :avocado:
Maya: Guilty, but only because I thought it was communal. Apologies!
Iris: There is a communal honor system and a tiny sticky-note judiciary.
Noah: Should we institute a 'toast tally' whiteboard? :white_small_square:
Kai: Or a solemn toast registry with fees and ceremonial buttering.
Maya: Will pay in coffee and puns.
Noah: Puns accepted. Example: 'That toast had a *toasty* personality.'
Iris: One-liner contest: best micro-pun about breakfast gets a sticker.
Maya: "Breadwinner of the office."
Kai: "Avocontrol issues."
Noah: "Toast to success (and snacks)."
SnackBot: Voting open: Maya, Kai, Noah. React with :star: for your fav.
Iris: :star: on Maya for pure braggadocio.
Kai: :star: on Kai ... humble self-vote.
Noah: :star: final vote for Noah. Tally: Maya 1, Kai 1, Noah 1. It's a glorious three-way tie. Stickers distributed by random drawer.
Maya: Also tiny PSA: label personal breakfasts in the fridge. There was a mysterious jar of kimchi that staged a coup.
Kai: Kimchi now banned from communal countertop unless declared in #kitchen.
Iris: New rule: if you bring something pungent, you also bring donuts to bribe the team.
Noah: Agreed. I'll bring donuts tomorrow to make amends for my breadwinning attitude.
SnackBot: Reminder: Kitchen clean-up party Friday 4pm. Bring gloves and good vibes.
Kai: Thanks all. Lesson learned: leave a sticky note or prepare a pun to plead your case. :clipboard:
